name: cable single arm row with rotation v. 3
description: A one-arm cable row that adds a torso rotation. It trains the back and the twisting muscles of the core.
instructions: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
